name: cipher-dashboard
description: CIPHER - Personal Crypto & NFT Dashboard (with Breakout Score)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:all --prefix breakout-score
scripts.build:breakout: npm install --include=dev --prefix breakout-score/client && npm run build --prefix breakout-score/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:breakout && concurrently -n cipher,breakout -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:cipher" "npm run dev:breakout"
